title: Machine Configuration Registers
statement: A machine configuration is a tuple of fifteen natural-number registers: the query length and decoding pointer, the pair-scan pointer, the input length, a scratch register, a loop counter, a radius, a vertex exponent, registers for $2n$ and $2n^2$, a width cap, a width-check pointer, an index and remaining offset, decoding and comparison scratch, a source vertex, and shift scratch.
